disposition_reason: Ten PTMs including As, Cd and Pb were measured by ICP-MS in 84 Turkish cheeses; the main text prints only overall ranges and some group maxima, while group statistics are in unavailable supplementary tables and medians are figure-only.

study.design: Purposive stratified market-based survey of 84 cheeses from seven regions, by milk source, ripening stage and production type
study.origin: cheeses produced in seven geographical regions of Türkiye (EAR 14, MR 14, AR 10, MER 10, BSR 11, CAR 14, SAR 11)
study.market: commercially available cheeses, two units per sample in original packaging
lod: LOD/LOQ in Supplementary Table S1 (not available); LOQs printed in text: Al 0.00215 mg/kg, Fe 0.00769 mg/kg, Cr 0.58, Ni 1.26, Cu 2.28, Se 0.91, Cd 0.06, Pb 2.19 µg/kg
study.qa: Recoveries 95.5-103%, RSD 2.22-4.57% (Table S1); no CRM named

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Legal limits applied: Cr 300 µg/kg, Pb 100 µg/kg (milk and dairy, as cited)
regulatory_or_exposure.value: four samples exceeded the Pb limit
Pb mean 0.02 µg/kg bw/day, max 1.00; THQ and HI below 1
